metadata.description: Public, general-purpose skills and plugins for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: kb-to-spec
plugins.description: Promote a private Markdown note into a shareable spec committed to a GitHub repo. Works with Claude Code and Codex. De-privatizes content, writes a standalone spec with an Authors header, links back from the private note, and keeps the two files independent.

plugins.name: js-perf-audit
plugins.description: Audit any JS-heavy codebase for performance issues. Checks bundle weight, code splitting, selector memoization, rendering architecture, and performance infrastructure. Produces a findings report with severity ratings and recommendations.

plugins.name: visual-screenshots
plugins.description: Capture before/after screenshots for PRs with visual UI changes using Playwright. Reads the repo's dev-server setup, captures matched before/after shots at multiple viewports, and can upload them straight into the PR comment as inline images. Works on github.com and GitHub Enterprise.

plugins.name: claude-cleanup
plugins.description: Audit and clean up Claude Code configuration. Checks skills, hooks, plugins, configs, commands, and stale data for issues and fixes them.

plugins.name: playwright-ui-check
plugins.description: Verify a product change in a login-gated UI - smoke checks, click and keyboard flows, DOM assertions and 2x screenshots for PR evidence - by logging in once in a visible browser, then attaching a headless browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol for every check after. For reading or editing a page, use a page-access skill instead.

plugins.name: flake-to-fact
plugins.description: Replace vague flaky-test language with the narrowest evidence-supported classification for test, build, deployment, performance, security, and CI failures. Separates recurrence from cause, records confidence, and requests a specific diagnostic when evidence is insufficient.

plugins.name: five-steps
plugins.description: Apply the 5-step optimization framework (question, delete, simplify, accelerate, automate—in that order) to a plan or an existing system, then edit the target in place.

plugins.name: unit-tests
plugins.description: Audit existing test suites for meaningful coverage, brittle checks, duplicated assertions, and genuine gaps. Improves test quality without blindly adding tests.

plugins.name: agent-build
plugins.description: Build a change with a coding agent and hand over a ready PR: five-steps first, a proven launch with a sized watcher, a multi-lens review, proof on the real path, a Definition of Done, every review comment answered, and CI fully green. A gate-check script verifies the gates before handoff.
